answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 16431 Country: LK Title: Assalamu alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakathuhu! During Witr Salat, the Imam was reading qunut and started weeping. Later another alim objected to this and said it is not permissible. We follow Shafi Mazhab in Sri Lanka. Shall be grateful for your opinion on this. Jezakallahu Khairan Question: Assalamu alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakathuhu! During Witr Salat, the Imam was reading qunut and started weeping. Later another alim objected to this and said it is not permissible. We follow Shafi Mazhab in Sri Lanka. Shall be grateful for your opinion on this. Jezakallahu Khairan Answer ID: 16431 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1889/1486/D=1430) Why the imam started weeping? If he wept because of physical pain, it will nullify the salah, the imam and the muqtadis should perform the salah again. But if he wept remembering the aakhirah or due to the fear of Jannah or Jahannam, the salah will not be nullified. This ruling is according to the Hanafi school of Fiqh . If you are a Shafi?i you should ask the question to any scholar of your maslak . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
